big: Nifty Capital Goods is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Capital Goods?
lines: What does the Nifty Capital Goods track?
Nifty Capital Goods Index aims to track the performance of stocks from the Nifty Total Market Index which form a part of the Capital Goods sector. It holds 50 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.

intro: NSE factsheet, 30 Sep 2026, as per the lesson. Past returns do not predict the future.
note: P/E is price relative to earnings. A higher P/E means investors pay more for each rupee of earnings.
